routes.description: The proven CatSul daily crossing (30 min, R$16.90, ~1,700 pax/day pre-flood). Haversine 6.6 nm; sailed distance ~8 nm as the navigation channel wraps south of the Jacuí delta shoals off the Gasômetro point.
Existing CatSul intermediate leg down the revitalised Orla (haversine 3.5 nm plus shoreline-following margin). Downtown to the Pontal district in under ten minutes.
Existing CatSul leg — 15 minutes Píer Pontal to Guaíba per operator FAQ (haversine 3.6 nm plus channel margin).
Short waterfront connector served by CatSul on weekends and during events (South Summit 2026 special stops); stitches Armazém B3 to the Embarcadero leisure complex.
Event-proven leg — CatSul's South Summit 2026 operation ran Embarcadero↔Pontal lunchtime shuttles. Natural corporate/event route along the Orla.

The Guaíba Sunset Run — from the Usina do Gasômetro, the city's sunset landmark, west across the golden-hour lake to Guaíba (haversine 5.8 nm plus delta-shoal channel margin). The incumbent sunset market already sells R$80-100 diesel happy-hour cruises; this is the marquee foiling experience.

Delta do Jacuí islands run — the corridor the Cisne Branco tours daily (1h loop, R$50) into the state-park delta; direct hop to Ilha da Pintada's fishing village and restaurants (haversine 2.0 nm plus island-channel wrap). Zero-wake foiling matters in the protected wetlands.
Gasômetro to the delta village — short spur linking the Orla's cultural anchor to Ilha da Pintada lunch traffic (haversine 1.9 nm plus channel wrap around the island edge).
Zona Sul marina spur — Pontal to the Veleiros do Sul sailing club, knitting the marina arc into the commuter string.
Cross-lake club run — Veleiros do Sul straight across to Guaíba town (haversine 2.9 nm), a natural weekend leisure pairing.
Southern cross-lake spur — Tristeza's Clube dos Jangadeiros to Guaíba, the shortest crossing on the lake (haversine 2.6 nm).
Retail-anchored commuter spur — BarraShoppingSul pier direct to Guaíba (haversine 3.6 nm plus margin), giving the far shore a one-seat ride to the Zona Sul retail hub.
Orla express — downtown to the Assunção marina cluster along the full revitalised waterfront (haversine 4.5 nm plus shoreline margin).

The state's flood-resilience corridor — Metroplan route study plus Eldorado do Sul's R$5.2M dredging (from Dec 2025) are building this link; distance left null because the Eldorado terminal site is not yet published (order-of-magnitude: a delta-channel run of several nm west of the Centro terminal).
